notes.title: City Pack 2 - Adventure
notes.content:
[h1]Fellow Voyagers,[/h1]

We have completed [b]14 more locations[/b] for you to discover. One of which is not even on planet Earth! We hope you enjoy these new locations, added for free to the base game. 

[h2]Special Location[/h2]

We wanted to spice up your travels a bit, so we added [b]The Moon[/b] as a location for you to visit. How you'll get there we are leaving for you to figure out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/f637debce4e2aeb8f46cdcb6c0ed3f713bada248.png[/img]

[h2]Other locations[/h2]

This time around the keyword is [b]adventure[/b], one such adventurous location being the [b]Galapagos Islands[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/b066a95af75b46c157150610c07dd547947541cb.png[/img]

And as it might be cold for you up on the moon, we also included another couple of cold places for you, so you'll feel right at home here on Earth as well: [b]The North Pole[/b], and [b]McMurdo (Antarctica)[/b].

It also felt timely to include [b]Kiev, Ukraine[/b] in this city pack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/da2b518c9559629e7b8e105f797425f826b07099.png[/img]

Us developers wish for [b]Peace for Ukraine! <3[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/730973e5d8ce8331c99fcee5b4f65dc3af76e289.png[/img]

[h2]Complete list of new locations:[/h2]

[b][list]
[*] Brussels, Belgium
[*] Cape Canaveral, USA
[*] Colombo, Sri Lanka
[*] Galapagos Islands, Ecuador
[*] Hawaii, USA
[*] Kathmandu, Nepal
[*] Kiev, Ukraine
[*] McMurdo, Antarctica
[*] Miami, USA
[*] The Moon
[*] Nuuk, Greenland
[*] The North Pole, Arctic
[*] San Francisco, USA
[*] Shanghai, China
[/list][/b]

[h3]Safe travels,[/h3]

Voyager devs

notes.title: City Pack 1
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Voyagers,[/h1]

[b]We have completed a set of new cities for you to visit.[/b]

[h2]The Nordics[/h2]

The first add-on is a [b]Nordic package[/b], which completes all capital cities of Scandinavia. In addition to [b]Stockholm[/b] in Sweden, now you can also explore [b]Copenhagen[/b] in Denmark, [b]Helsinki[/b] in Finland, [b]Oslo[/b] in Norway, and [b]Reykjavik[/b] on Iceland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/4156b7e395ed9d13a9847ad1a2658a8593ff5fd0.png[/img]

[h2]Eastern Europe[/h2]

Furthermore, there have been requests for two other European cities, [b]Sofia[/b] in Bulgaria, and [b]Warsaw[/b] in Poland. We have added these cities as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/9d4d92ae42a2023910923fc22d4f20ac8ea4643c.png[/img]

[h2]Available in the base game[/h2]

Of course, these new cities will be available in the base game, with no additional cost.

The cities are available in English and Swedish, for now. Translation to other languages is not yet complete. If you are playing in Spanish or Portuguese, these new cities will currently default to English.

Expect more content in the future.

[h3]Have fun![/h3]
